previous._exit_check_rule: A stage's exit is MET only when every condition has a command AND every command exits 0. A condition with no command is UNCHECKED and blocks the stage from ever reporting met — deliberately, because the alternative is a stage that declares itself complete on the strength of the conditions someone happened to automate. Unchecked is not neutral; it is the reason the stage cannot be called done.
